title: Family Portrait in Mexico, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1940s black-and-white snapshot depicting a family group consisting of a woman, a young girl, and an older gentleman holding a hat. They are resting against a stone wall featuring clay tile roof trim characteristic of Spanish colonial architecture. A carved stone head rests near the bottom left, and the man wears traditional woven leather sandals (huaraches).
